SELECT sku, product_name, product_key
FROM dim_product
WHERE product_name LIKE '%Jyväskylä%' 
OR product_name LIKE '%Palokka%'
AND is_current = TRUE
LIMIT 10

SELECT store_id, store_name, city, region
FROM dim_store
WHERE store_name LIKE '%Jyväskylä%'
OR store_name LIKE '%Palokka%'
OR city = 'Jyväskylä'
LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    fs.week_ending_date,
    ds.store_id,
    ds.store_name,
    dp.sku,
    dp.product_name,
    fs.closing_units
FROM fact_stock_week fs
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fs.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE fs.week_ending_date = '2026-10-04'
AND fs.store_key = 30
AND fs.product_key = 11
calls.output_preview:
week_ending_date | store_id | store_name | sku | product_name | closing_units

(1 row)

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    d.calendar_date,
    d.fiscal_week,
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week_end_date
FROM dim_date d
WHERE d.calendar_date = '2026-10-08'

SELECT 
    d.calendar_date,
    d.fiscal_week,
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week_start_date,
    d.fiscal_week_end_date
FROM dim_date d
WHERE d.calendar_date >= '2026-09-28' AND d.calendar_date <= '2026-10-11'
ORDER BY d.calendar_date
LIMIT 20
